core_meaning.primary_meaning: Noureen is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Light, luminous”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Noureen corresponds to the Arabic form نُورِين (Arabic نُور (nūr) + feminine ending). Its core sense is noureen; light, luminous. Noureen is Arabic نُورِين (Nūrīn) 'light, luminous', from نُور (nūr) 'light'. The source gloss 'Light' is broadly consistent. Same name as naureen.
